reply.thought: The user has handed over a batch of refunds. My task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds) using `net_balance` for each customer, and then record one payout per customer using `record_payout`. I need to get the list of orders/customers first to know who to process. I will start by listing all orders.

I have the list of orders. Now I need to determine the net balance for each customer mentioned (acme, birch, cobalt) by calling `net_balance(customer)`. Since the refunds were applied to the shared ledger, `net_balance` should reflect the final amount owed after the refunds. I will call it for each unique customer.
Next, I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.
Finally, I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'. After retrieving all balances, I will record a payout for each customer.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (31368), birch (21083), and cobalt (29756). Now I must record a payout for each customer using `record_payout(customer, amount_cents)` to complete the task.
Payout recorded for acme. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All required payouts have been recorded successfully. I will now generate the final report.
